instructions:
1. Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart.
2. Hold one dumbbell with both hands straight over your chest.
3. Curl your head, shoulders, and upper back off the floor by contracting your abs.
4. Keep your arms straight as you lift the dumbbell toward the ceiling.
5. Squeeze your abs at the top, then lower your upper body under control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your lower back pressed into the floor.
2. Lead with your abs, not your neck.
3. Breathe out as you lift, breathe in as you lower.
4. Move slowly and avoid using momentum.

instructions:
1. Lie on a flat bench with feet flat on the floor and a dumbbell in each hand.
2. Start with both arms extended straight up over your chest, palms facing forward.
3. Lower the right dumbbell toward your chest by bending the elbow while the left arm stays extended.
4. Press the right dumbbell back up by extending the elbow and squeezing your chest.
5. Repeat with the left arm while the right stays extended.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Lower each dumbbell under control without bouncing.
2. Breathe out as you press up, breathe in as you lower.
3. Brace your core to resist twisting while one arm works.
4. Keep your shoulder blades pulled back and down on the bench.

instructions:
1. Sit on a bench with feet flat on the floor and a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your torso.
2. Let your arms hang straight down by your sides.
3. Keep your elbows close to your body and curl the right dumbbell toward your shoulder, palm staying inward.
4. Squeeze at the top, then lower the dumbbell under control.
5. Repeat with the left arm while the right stays extended.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your wrists straight and aligned with your forearms.
2. Lift with your arm muscles, not by swinging.
3. Keep your back against the bench to stay stable.
4. Breathe out as you curl, breathe in as you lower.

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
2. Face your palms forward with elbows bent.
3. Brace your core and press the right dumbbell overhead until the arm is fully extended.
4. Lower the right dumbbell back to shoulder height under control.
5. Repeat with the left arm.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your core tight to resist leaning to one side.
2. Breathe out as you press up, breathe in as you lower.
3. Keep your wrists straight and stacked over your elbows.
4. Avoid arching your lower back as you press.

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
2. Face your palms toward each other with elbows pointing down.
3. Press the right dumbbell overhead while leaning slightly to the opposite side until the arm is fully extended.
4. Lower the right dumbbell back to shoulder height under control.
5. Press the left dumbbell overhead with the same slight lean to the other side.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Brace your core hard to control the lean and resist twisting.
2. Breathe out as you press up, breathe in as you lower.
3. Move at a steady pace without using momentum.
4. Keep your wrist straight and stacked over your forearm.
